notes: Inbound from a call-summary/enablement app builder. Uses LLMs to produce exec summaries + talk tracks.
Primary ask: hosted API self-serve for quick integration into their SaaS. Prefer AWS us-east-1.
PII concern: customers often include phone numbers, emails, and credit card fragments in call transcripts.
Asks: how long do you store audio/text? need deletion API and configurable retention windows.
Wants: in-flight PII redaction or tokenization before persistence; ability to disable storage entirely.
Cost sensitivity: SMB - low monthly spend initially (pilot). Looking for predictable per-minute / per-token pricing.
Latency: real-time-ish for UI - target 300-600ms per token for short summaries, batching ok for nightly reruns.
Model preferences: open models okay but want deterministic fallback to smaller models when cost spikes.
Quote from founder: 'We can't surface PII in the summary — must have scrub-first option or we won't move forward.'
Technical note: currently using WebRTC transcription -> sends text to backend. Wants to cut in Redwood API before storing transcripts.
Requested artifacts: security FAQ, retention API spec, sample contract language for data handling.
Next demo asks: show retention UI, show API calls for delete + redact, show logs/audit for sample tokens.
Potential upsell: if Dedicated or Private becomes necessary for regulated customers, may expand later.
